label: input w at mid original positions (t=4-5), sequence started with r/h/1
explanation: Very sparse unit (0.03% of steps). Fires almost only when the input token is w (99.9% of activation mass), only in the original phase, and only at positions t=3..6 (88% of mass at t=4-5). It never fires on the delimiter or copy steps, at t<=2 or t>=7, or on any other input token. But input w at t=3..6 is necessary, not sufficient: only about 4% of those steps fire. Activation is much more likely when the first original token is r, h or 1 (about 7x lift, roughly 73% of mass). Requiring that and t=4-5 gives dev F1 0.47. The remaining dependence on earlier context is not captured by a simple predicate.
